open_points.subject: _confirmation_binding_digest
open_points.text:
Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,
  setattr, delattr, or vars; a declared field or operation is
  addressed by its name, including in try/finally cleanup, and a
  model's fields are read generically only by iterating the model.
open_points.other_text: _confirmation_binding_digest: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] MUST answer the hexadecimal text of a collision-resistant cryptographic digest of one unambiguous serialisation of the action, then the target, then the version, then every field of inputs in the order its model declares them, lists in the order given and an absent value told apart from an empty one, so that equal arguments always give equal serialisations and so equal digests, and different arguments always different serialisations, two of which share a digest only by a collision of the digest itself, never by the serialisation; walking inputs it MUST take a model's fields, each name with its value in their declared order, and tell a model from any other value only through model_items, and take a tuple's elements in their order.
open_points.question: Must generic model-field reading iterate the model directly, or must it use model_items as the exclusive model-detection and field-reading operation?
